dataHealth.ll2Description: Launch Library 2 is the world's most comprehensive rocket launch database, maintained by TheSpaceDevs. It provides standardized data on launch missions, agencies, rockets, launch sites, astronauts, and spacecraft.
dataHealth.syncSchedule: Launches 6h / agencies 24h / rockets 24h / launch sites 7d / astronauts 7d / spacecraft 7d
dataHealth.accuracyNoticeText: Launch schedules may change at any time due to weather, technical issues, or other factors. SpaceData strives to keep data current but cannot guarantee absolute accuracy. For mission-critical decisions, please consult official launch provider sources directly. If you find any data errors, please report them through our support channels.
